## Problem

What are you trying to do that modelshift does not handle today.

## Proposed change

The command, flag, or registry change you have in mind. A sample of the input (file, prompt line, or provider response) helps a lot.

## Source

For registry additions, link the provider's official lifecycle or deprecation page. Entries without a source URL are not merged.
